pages.text:
Meters sit in a line and measure what flows through them (however much, the Heat Meter aside): in on the left side (as you face the screen), out on the right. The Flip button in the GUI turns them round (in on the right), and the arrow on the front points the way they flow.
- Energy Meter: FE.
- Heat Meter: heat, up to 51,200 HU/t (an Arcforged Thermal Conduit's rate; set in the config).
- Fluid Meter: liquids only.
- Gas Meter: gases only, through Pressurized Conduits.
The front screen shows the live rate.
# Redstone
In the GUI, set a threshold and a mode:
- Above: signal while the rate is above the threshold.
- Below: signal while the rate is below it.
The meter outputs a signal of 15 on every side while the condition holds, and its LED lights. A comparator reads the rate on its own: 0 when idle, 15 at the meter's full scale (an Arcforged conduit's rate: 262,144 FE/t, 51,200 HU/t, 12,800 mB/t of liquid, 25,600 mB/t of gas; set in the config) or above.
